title: The merch: who collects it on Monday 9 Nov, where, and the fallback if Monday slips
detail: The printer cannot guarantee Friday 6 Nov (colours ordered in); procurement@web-summit.silvio asked whether Monday 9 Nov morning works (7bca9e67, 10:40). The summit starts on Tuesday 10, our stand day is Thursday 12. Not yet recorded: who collects, from where, and how it reaches Lisbon; and what happens if Monday morning slips.
recommend: Ask the printer today for a firm Monday-morning time and, if it can, a courier to Lisbon; Silvio names who collects. If it cannot commit by Thursday, split, so the cards at least are in hand before the summit.
options: Silvio collects on Monday morning and brings it to Lisbon that day
The printer couriers it to a Lisbon address of Silvio's choosing for Monday
Split: whatever is ready Friday (e.g. cards) goes first, the rest Monday
